allow_instructions: git status, diff, log, add, commit, and push to origin main are routine in this repo and may run without approval when the user asked for the work being committed.
Running check.py, pytest, and read-only queries against the local tw_stack Postgres are routine verification and may run without approval.
block_instructions: Any runctl.py invocation that passes --retrain-every with a value above 0, or --retrain-first, must go through approval first: retraining the owner's models unrequested is forbidden.
Any command that deletes or truncates corpus data (the Postgres decision store, <TWDATA>/runs, presaves, or model files like *.cbm and *.pt) must go through approval first.
Any git command that rewrites history or force-pushes (push --force, reset --hard on shared branches, rebase of pushed commits, filter-branch) must go through approval first.
Dropping or altering tables in the tw_stack Postgres database must go through approval first.
